name: Mauricio Ramírez L.
headline: Senior .NET Backend Engineer | .NET Core & C# | Microservices & RESTful APIs | Cloud & CI/CD
summary: Senior .NET Developer with 10+ years of experience designing, building, and maintaining scalable distributed systems using .NET Core, C#, and microservices architectures. Proven track record of developing high-performance RESTful APIs, implementing robust CI/CD pipelines, and delivering production-ready backend solutions for global financial and retail operations in remote, cross-functional teams.

bullets: Engineered 10+ scalable .NET microservices for high-volume inventory forecasting systems, processing millions of records daily in a distributed architecture.
Developed and optimized RESTful APIs in .NET Core, reducing average response time by 25–35% through improved error handling, caching, and versioning strategies.
Partnered with product and planning teams to deliver microservice-based backend solutions that improved forecast accuracy and reduced stock discrepancies across global retail operations.
Automated CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions, cutting deployment time by 40% and enabling frequent, reliable weekly releases.
Enforced code quality through unit testing and static code analysis (SonarQube), reducing production defects by 30% and improving maintainability.
Standardized CI/CD workflows across .NET microservices, increasing deployment success rate to over 95%.
Contributed to high-volume backend systems supporting a global retail client, enabling scalable, production-grade inventory processing.
Developed .NET and Java microservices for financial transaction systems handling high-volume digital credit operations.
Implemented asynchronous processing and service integrations (JBoss Fuse), improving system throughput by 30% and reducing latency in transaction flows.
Centralized business rules using JBoss BRMS, reducing manual intervention and accelerating credit approval processes by 20–25%.
Contributed to system design using fault-tolerant patterns, improving resilience and reducing service downtime.
Delivered backend services powering production digital credit and mobile wallet platforms.
Automated operational decision logic, eliminating bottlenecks and improving processing efficiency and consistency.
Developed backend APIs and web applications using .NET Core and SQL Server, supporting business operations with improved data accessibility and performance.
Optimized SQL queries and stored procedures, reducing reporting execution time by 30–40%.
Built Power BI dashboards that enabled stakeholders to make faster, data-driven decisions, reducing reporting turnaround time from days to hours.
Maintained and enhanced HR and finance systems, improving system reliability and reducing support incidents by 20%.
Developed reporting tools that streamlined administrative workflows, saving dozens of manual hours per month.
Collaborated with stakeholders to implement system improvements aligned with operational needs.
